eventDetail.scope: Smart robotics combines diverse concepts and techniques to create devices, manipulators, and autonomous systems that serve various human communities - from manufacturing to medical and remote manipulators in complex environments. Control technologies are essential to these systems, enabling robot creators to develop effective strategies to meet their goals. This conference is a great opportunity to engage with world-class experts and young researchers, tackle multidisciplinary challenges, and participate in mentoring opportunities.
